subject: planner: add hash64 and equal for maxOneRow and fix some bugs. (#57259)
summary: Fixes `AggFuncDesc.Equals` to correctly compare embedded `baseFuncDesc`; extends hash64/equals codegen to `LogicalMaxOneRow`; aligns generated slice `Equals` with existing Hash64 nil-vs-empty handling to maintain hash/equality consistency; updates logicalop tests and Bazel sharding accordingly.
